ENVIRONMENTAL ACTIVITIES — TERMLY EXAM #20
====

GRADE: Grade 1
SUBJECT: ENVIRONMENTAL ACTIVITIES
TIME ALLOWED: 1 hour 30 minutes
TOTAL MARKS: 50
EXAM BODY: KPSEA

INSTRUCTIONS
----
1. Answer all questions.
2. For calculations, show formula → substitution → steps → final answer with units.
3. For multiple choice, choose the best option.
4. Check your work before submitting.

SECTION A — MULTIPLE CHOICE
----
1. Diffusion is best described as: (1 mark)
   A. Net movement of particles from high to low concentration
   B. Movement of water only across a membrane
   C. A chemical reaction forming ash
   D. Heating until a solid melts

2. An element is: (1 mark)
   A. Any white crystal used in cooking
   B. A mixture of two liquids
   C. Any substance that conducts electricity
   D. A pure substance that cannot be broken down into a simpler substance by chemical means

3. Which change is a physical change? (1 mark)
   A. Milk souring
   B. Ice melting to water
   C. Paper burning to ash
   D. Iron rusting

4. Which practice best shows correct science when studying Weather and Sky its resources? (1 mark)
   A. Observe carefully, use correct terms, and follow safety rules for Weather and Sky its resources.
   B. Taste unknown substances to “learn faster” about Weather and Sky its resources.
   C. Guess results without recording observations on Weather and Sky its resources.
   D. Skip labelling diagrams related to Weather and Sky its resources.

5. The SI unit of force is the: (1 mark)
   A. newton (N)
   B. watt (W)
   C. joule (J)
   D. pascal (Pa)

6. Which practice best shows correct science when studying Exploring weather? (1 mark)
   A. Observe carefully, use correct terms, and follow safety rules for Exploring weather.
   B. Guess results without recording observations on Exploring weather.
   C. Skip labelling diagrams related to Exploring weather.
   D. Taste unknown substances to “learn faster” about Exploring weather.

7. Which practice best shows correct science when studying Uses of water? (1 mark)
   A. Taste unknown substances to “learn faster” about Uses of water.
   B. Observe carefully, use correct terms, and follow safety rules for Uses of water.
   C. Skip labelling diagrams related to Uses of water.
   D. Guess results without recording observations on Uses of water.

8. Which practice best shows correct science when studying Caring for c) develop positive attitude towards things found in the home (cleani? (1 mark)
   A. Skip labelling diagrams related to Caring for c) develop positive attitude towards things found in the home (cleani.
   B. Taste unknown substances to “learn faster” about Caring for c) develop positive attitude towards things found in the home (cleani.
   C. Observe carefully, use correct terms, and follow safety rules for Caring for c) develop positive attitude towards things found in the home (cleani.
   D. Guess results without recording observations on Caring for c) develop positive attitude towards things found in the home (cleani.

9. In a food chain, green plants are usually: (1 mark)
   A. Tertiary consumers
   B. Decomposers only
   C. Producers
   D. Primary consumers only

10. Boiling point of pure water at standard pressure is about: (1 mark)
   A. 37 °C
   B. 50 °C
   C. 100 °C
   D. 0 °C

11. A compound differs from a mixture because: (1 mark)
   A. A mixture always has a fixed melting point
   B. Elements in a compound are chemically combined in a fixed ratio
   C. A compound can be separated by filtering only
   D. Mixtures cannot exist in Kenya

12. Which practice best shows correct science when studying Keeping home? (1 mark)
   A. Skip labelling diagrams related to Keeping home.
   B. Observe carefully, use correct terms, and follow safety rules for Keeping home.
   C. Guess results without recording observations on Keeping home.
   D. Taste unknown substances to “learn faster” about Keeping home.

13. Which practice best shows correct science when studying Plants its resources? (1 mark)
   A. Guess results without recording observations on Plants its resources.
   B. Observe carefully, use correct terms, and follow safety rules for Plants its resources.
   C. Skip labelling diagrams related to Plants its resources.
   D. Taste unknown substances to “learn faster” about Plants its resources.

14. Photosynthesis mainly produces: (1 mark)
   A. Only water vapour
   B. Glucose and oxygen
   C. Nitrogen gas only
   D. Only carbon dioxide

15. Which practice best shows correct science when studying Soil its resources? (1 mark)
   A. Guess results without recording observations on Soil its resources.
   B. Taste unknown substances to “learn faster” about Soil its resources.
   C. Observe carefully, use correct terms, and follow safety rules for Soil its resources.
   D. Skip labelling diagrams related to Soil its resources.

16. Soil erosion is reduced by: (1 mark)
   A. Overgrazing continuously
   B. Burning crop residue every week
   C. Planting cover crops and terracing slopes
   D. Removing all vegetation

SECTION B — STRUCTURED / SHORT ANSWERS
----
17. In three clear sentences, explain Enterprise projects environment and give one Kenyan example. (4 marks)

18. In three clear sentences, explain Exploring and give one Kenyan example. (4 marks)

19. In three clear sentences, explain Caring for plants environment and give one Kenyan example. (4 marks)

20. In three clear sentences, explain Caring for animals environment and give one Kenyan example. (4 marks)

21. In three clear sentences, explain Managing waste environment and give one Kenyan example. (4 marks)

22. In three clear sentences, explain Safety in handling and give one Kenyan example. (4 marks)
